Request a Consultation Memberships Financing Gift Cards Skincare Products Request a Consultation Request a Consultation Back Kerry Newhall, LE Master Esthetician Locations: Dover Kerry is a Master Esthetician who has been an integral part of the Skin Health team since 2006. She holds a Bachelor’s degree in Theater Arts, with a focus on makeup application and design, and completed her aesthetics training at the Michael School of Hair Design in 2003. With a deep passion for her industry and the clients she serves, Kerry specializes in advanced anti-aging therapies, including Hydrafacial, SKNLAB, Excelis, VirtuRF, and IPL treatments, among others. Known for her extensive knowledge, honesty, and warm demeanor, Kerry has cultivated a loyal and compassionate following over the years. As one of the earliest members of the Skin Health team, she brings both experience and dedication to every client interaction.
